description: This file defines a namespace 'Utils::String' containing various string utility functions, such as case-insensitive comparisons, trimming, splitting, encoding, and configuration file manipulations related to system modes.

classes.name: loc_equal
classes.description: A template struct for locale-aware character comparison, used for case-insensitive comparison operations.

methods.name: find_substr_ci
methods.description: Performs a case-insensitive search for a substring within a string, returning the position or -1 if not found.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if a string contains a given substring in a case-insensitive manner.

methods.name: equal
methods.description: Performs a case-insensitive equality check between two strings.

methods.name: ltrim
methods.description: Removes whitespace characters from the start of a string.

methods.name: rtrim
methods.description: Removes whitespace characters from the end of a string.

methods.name: trim
methods.description: Removes whitespace characters from both ends of a string.

methods.name: stringContains
methods.description: Performs a case-insensitive check for substring presence between two strings.

methods.name: split
methods.description: Splits a string into a vector of substrings based on delimiter characters.

methods.name: imageEncoder
methods.description: Encodes a byte array into a Base64 string.

methods.name: replaceString
methods.description: Replaces all occurrences of a substring within a string with another substring.

methods.name: updateSystemModeFile
methods.description: Updates the system mode configuration file by adding, deleting, or modifying specific entries.

methods.name: getSystemModePropertyValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specified property from the system mode configuration file.
